betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Tired of hunting for redstone? Electric Mushrooms grow on fungus-dominated planets with glowing purple caps that emit redstone-level signals. They're the final milestone in the alien planet materials questline.

The mushroom emits a 15-block redstone signal when placed and zaps any mob within 2 blocks with lightning. You can use them as a natural redstone source in remote bases.

After completing this quest, you have samples from 7 unique planet types and are ready to begin the Atmosphere Terraformer (10070) and Interstellar Mission chains.

§cWARNING:§f The mushroom emits lightning when touched. Without a Space Suit (10049) with electrical insulation, you take 4 HP per touch. The standard suit handles this.

§ePS:§f Place a ring of 8 mushrooms around a Redstone Lamp for a 15-block-radius redstone alarm system. They also provide light level 12, useful for underground farms.
